source: For conversion, K/V heads within each target group are mean-pooled to initialize the shared K/V head. The converted model is then continued in pretraining. The paper’s headline experiments used only 5% of the original pretraining compute for this uptraining stage.ZXMATH0000XZ
zh: 为了进行转换，对每个目标组内的 K/V 头进行均值池化以初始化共享 K/V 头。然后将转换后的模型继续进行预训练。该论文的标题实验仅在这个上训练阶段使用了原始预训练计算的 5%。ZXMATH0000XZ
